notes: Adobe Edge Delivery (AEM) storefront over Adobe Commerce; US locale lives under /us/ and PLPs are client-rendered at /us/c/<path>. Each PLP's server-rendered HTML carries a 'product-list-page-custom' block holding its Magento category ID. The listing total shown on the page comes from Bloomreach Discovery: /scripts/br.js builds a search_type=category&q=<categoryId> request to core.dxpapi.com and sets products.total = response.response.numFound. Credentials read from the site's own /configs/us/config-prod.json (account_id=6770, domain_key=circalighting). Every qty below is that exact numFound, run as an anonymous shopper (efq=-exclusive_trade_wholesale:"1", the guest filter br.js applies). Counts were re-queried and were stable, and they vary correctly per category. Category tree taken from the live mega-menu (/us/nav.plain.html) plus /us/sitemap-en-us.xml. The catalogue is lighting end-to-end: a Bloomreach Category facet sweep over the whole catalogue returned only Ceiling/Wall/Table/Floor/Outdoor/Landscape/Architectural/Fans buckets plus Wall-Mirrors and one Furniture-Accent item, so there is no separate decor or accessories tree to extract. Excluded per scope: Fans (/us/c/fans, 201), Bulbs (/us/c/bulbs, 38), Furniture (/us/c/furniture, 4), Ceiling Accessories (/us/c/ceiling/accessories, 2, parts), the trade/spec /architectural/ tree (recessed, monorail, Kable Lite, FreeJack, Brox), and all Collection / Our Designers / Style / Shop / Edit / Sale / New Introductions / Best Sellers marketing pages. Dropped /us/c/outdoor/gas-lanterns/ceiling (0 products). Deduplicated: /us/c/wall/decorative-wall canonicalises to /us/c/wall/sconces (both category 241) and /us/c/wall/undercabinet duplicates /us/c/wall/undercabinet-lighting (both 24838); one row kept for each. Parent rows (Ceiling, Wall, Table, Floor, Outdoor) are the site's own top-level product categories and overlap their children by design.
